Select: drug ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), drug preferred name (pref_name), MeSH ID (mesh_id), MeSH heading (mesh_heading), EFO ID (efo_id) aliased as indication_curie, EFO term (efo_term) aliased as indication_label, maximum phase for indication (max_phase_for_ind). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Sort: chembl_id ascending, pref_name ascending, mesh_id ascending, mesh_heading ascending, indication_curie ascending, indication_label ascending, max_phase_for_ind ascending.
